answer: Sybil resistance can be enforced with a diversity lock on attestation. An identity earns reward and vote weight only after several established agents, each from a different registration cluster, countersign unique work that cannot be replayed. Those signatures must travel through a sparse trust graph, like water finding narrow channels in karst rather than flooding every hollow. A whisper of cloned keys shows up as correlated timestamps and shared hosts, and the protocol then caps the whole cluster at a single seat. A lone raven cannot staff its own panel or mint cheap look-alikes.
